text:
[issue by SrNadien]
I switched to single-player mode and the same error keeps happening.

And the same crash occurs.
https://mclo.gs/DmqsTL3

💥 Crash Description

The crash occurs while the server is ticking block entities (such as chests or storage blocks).

The error originates from:

Sophisticated Core → InventoryHandler
Sophisticated Storage → StorageBlockEntity.onLoad

This indicates that the issue happens when a storage block from Sophisticated Storage is being loaded into the world.

⚠️ What is happening

When the game tries to load a storage block entity, it crashes during the inventory handling process.

This suggests that:

The block entity's inventory data is being processed
Something goes wrong inside the inventory logic during the load phase (onLoad)
📌 Key Details
Crash phase: Block entity ticking / loading
Affected system: Inventory handling
Involved classes:
InventoryHandler (Sophisticated Core)
StorageBlockEntity.onLoad (Sophisticated Storage)
🔁 Steps to Reproduce
Launch the game/server with the modpack installed
Load into an existing world (or create a new one)
Place a Sophisticated Storage block (e.g., chest, barrel, etc.)
Interact with it (store items, upgrade it, or modify its contents)
Leave the area or restart the game/server
Return to the area where the storage block is located

➡️ The game crashes when the block entity is loaded again (during chunk loading / world load)
